Karpathy on AI’s 30 under 30

Money is an information system for labor allocation. (this tweet)

Money doesn’t have any intrinsic power. You can’t simply throw more money into a system and hope it would fix the problem.
Chaos is produced from the act of generating wealth.
What does it really means by accumulating wealth? If capital gains is a property in the pursuit for knowledge, chances are you will enjoy your time.
The problems with curiosity without alignment of capitalism is that you will run out of time and money sooner or later.
free market
See also Capitalism and Freedom (Friedman & Friedman, 1962)bibliographieFriedman, M., & Friedman, R. D. (1962). Capitalism and Freedom (p. 202). University of Chicago Press.
